decision_rationale: DistilBERT chosen over TF-IDF+LogReg: 0.921-0.932 F1 on stacked and 0.973-0.978 on time_blind (vs 0.700/0.812), the two classes this project stacked/time_blind confusion analysis concerns, at a still real-time-compatible 2.8ms latency. See report/metrics/branch1_architecture_comparison.json.
update_note: 20/8: dataset deduplicated by query_canonical BEFORE the train/test split to remove cross-split leakage (audit Mảng 2: 949 identical texts straddled train & test, 4,277 extra copies). branch1_train.csv now has 0 duplicate/straddling texts. Model retrained on the clean split; this eval is leakage-free. F1-macro 0.9822 (leaky) -> 0.9907 (clean) - it rose because dedup also let the undersampler draw 15k DISTINCT rows/class from a much larger pool, so training data is more diverse.
caveats: boolean_blind class has ~13% measured label noise (see data_contract.md Muc 3.1).
True robustness must be measured on the adversarial test set, not this clean test split.
stacked class excluded from training (16/7) - see data_contract.md Muc 3.3.
Content-format duplication (/blog/index.php/2020/... ~17.6%, audit Mảng 4) still lowers per-class diversity - not a leak, but keep in mind when reading these numbers.
